text: On August 11, between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, approximately 12% of API requests failed with HTTP 502 errors. The issue began after a deploy that removed the cache warmup step, leaving some backends unprepared to serve traffic. At 14:27 UTC we reverted the deploy, restoring the previous configuration. Error rates returned to normal by 14:31 UTC. No data loss occurred. We are reinstating cache warmup in our deploy process and adding checks to catch similar gaps before release. We apologize for the disruption.
